author: Mark
body: Best article I've seen on cooking regular steel cut oats in microwave, and the only one that reflects an understanding of how these ovens work. I've been using my microwave to do quick steel cut oats (with 100% and 50% power cycles), with great results. Your article inspires me to try the regular steel cut oats in the microwave as well. Thanks.

author: Federico Hatoum
body: Thanks Mark! I'm glad you enjoyed the post. :-D

author: Don Julian
body: Thank you for figuring this out for us!! It sure takes all the trial and error out of wasting oats as they constantly go up and over the side of the bowl making a huge mess!! Your recipe is so simple but genius at the same time!!
